evidence.why: Detachment precedes traversal across <= priority values.
Display consumes the resulting list order.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline's unconditional preservation of equal-priority relative order across reinsertion.
facts.value: Establishes callback and GX submission order within a GObj's SObj list by ascending numeric u8 priority. The supplied node is detached and inserted after existing equal-priority nodes in the remaining list. Other nodes retain their relative order, but reinserting an existing node at the same priority can move it behind its former equal-priority peers.

evidence.why: Canonical definition, NULL guard, unlink and free.

facts.rationale: Preserves the supported type and nullable single-object semantics while removing an unqualified hypothetical identifier from the signature.
facts.value: Canonical signature: void HSD_SObjLib_803A466C(HSD_SObj* sobj). The parameter is a nullable pointer to one SObj whose list membership and allocator lifetime are to be ended. HSD_SObjRemove is a separate naming hypothesis, not the canonical declaration.

evidence.why: Canonical definition and nullable saved-successor traversal.

facts.rationale: Corrects the same alias-as-signature defect in the whole-chain routine.
facts.value: Canonical signature: void HSD_SObjLib_803A4740(HSD_SObj* sobj). The argument is a nullable pointer to the first node of the forward chain to consume. HSD_SObjRemoveAll is a separate naming hypothesis, not the canonical declaration.

evidence.why: Logical reads and embedded primary/TLUT addresses.
Texture register-ID writes and call chain.

facts.rationale: Repairs the false transitive immutability claim using the actual GX callees and distinguishes descriptor mutation from unchanged logical sprite fields.
facts.value: Reads SObj flags, dimensions, position, angle, scales, UV bounds, colors and embedded texture descriptors to configure GX/HSD state and emit four XY/UV vertex pairs. The renderer itself leaves logical transform, list, dimensions, UV, flag and color fields unchanged, but the containing SObj is not transitively immutable: with 0x10 clear, GXLoadTexObj loads the embedded primary descriptor and, when 0x4 is set, the secondary descriptor; GXLoadTexObjPreLoaded writes their mode0, mode1, image0 and image3 register-ID fields. For C4/C8, GXLoadTlut also writes the embedded TLUT descriptor's region offset. The epilogue invalidates/resets selected shared state rather than restoring arbitrary incoming state.

facts.rationale: Preserves the renderer purpose while correcting the overly broad state-restoration guarantee.
facts.value: Renders one visible HSD_SObj as a rotated, scaled, textured quadrilateral. It selects texture, palette, TEV, blending and depth behavior from flags and texture format, emits four transformed XY/UV vertices, then conditionally disables Z texturing, invalidates HSD state, initializes TEV state, clears vertex descriptors and requests enabled LEQUAL depth testing with writes. This is a known-state cleanup boundary, not restoration of arbitrary incoming HSD/GX state.

evidence.why: Flag precedence, active counts, loads and specialized programming.
Format switch lacks default and includes C14X2.

facts.rationale: Preserves exceptional overlapping-flag behavior, palette distinctions, unsupported-format behavior and the precise cleanup boundary.
facts.value: Flag 0x1 returns before graphics setup. Flag 0x2 uses the stored position as center; otherwise the center includes half the scaled dimensions. Flag 0x4 selects Z-texture replacement, LESS testing, one texgen and two active TEV stages; 0x8 disables writes within that path. Only with 0x4 clear does 0x10 select two texgens/four active stages. Independently, 0x10 selects specialized stage-0-through-3 programming, external texture-map inputs and no blending, while skipping embedded primary and secondary loads. Thus 0x4|0x10 retains one texgen/two active stages while programming the specialized branch; its intended validity is unestablished. C4/C8 alone trigger the local TLUT load; C14X2 is handled by the ordinary TEV switch without that load. The format switch has no default. Completed draws conditionally disable Z texturing and perform fixed HSD/TEV/vertex/depth resets, not saved-state restoration.

evidence.why: Existing GObj input and CObj-only allocation.

facts.rationale: Corrects the baseline statement that the routine creates the camera GObj.
facts.value: Allocates and configures an orthographic HSD_CObj for an SObj rendering pass, attaches it to the existing caller-supplied HSD_GObj, and registers HSD_SObjLib_803A54EC at the requested render priority. It does not allocate the GObj.

evidence.why: Unsigned priority and registration without unlink.

facts.rationale: Corrects attachment/re-registration lifetime assumptions and distinguishes the render-pass mask from the group mask.
facts.value: Locally unguarded setup allocates and configures a fresh CObj, then attaches it through an API that asserts gobj->obj_kind is HSD_GOBJ_OBJ_NONE. It does not destroy or detach a previous object, and GX-link registration does not first remove an existing GX membership; repeated setup is not an unconditional replacement operation. The int priority is forwarded to the u32 GX-link API on gx_link_max+1. When scheduled, the callback activates the camera; success performs matrix/texgen/channel setup, dispatches render pass 0 to groups selected by gobj->gxlink_prios, and ends the camera. Failure reports Out CameraDisp Range. Both paths invalidate HSD state and request depth mode (1,3,1). Setup here does not initialize gxlink_prios.
